prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, an existing PLAGUEFALL game UI concept. Image 2 is the EXACT authorized Sindicato dos Trabalhadores Espaciais (STE) emblem to insert. Make one localized replacement only: replace the burning-coal / flame BRASA pictogram with a faithful scaled pixel-art rendition of the supplied union badge. Preserve its red/orange cogwheel border, dark navy center, cream rocket whose base forms an open-ended wrench, light-blue orbital swoosh and small cream star, and lower plaque with the exact letters "STE". This must be the supplied existing STE logo, not a generic union symbol, not a fist, no new logo design. Scale the complete emblem proportionally to fit inside the old pictogram's available footprint, including STE plaque. The old fire and embers must be completely removed and the black background clean. Keep image 1 dimensions, all other icons, all other text, every UI border, background, layout, palette and typography unchanged. Preserve crisp square-pixel appearance and the readability of the new symbol. No additional symbols, no watermark. The icon to replace is position 3, the left cell of the middle row in the six-icon grid. Replace its label "BRASA" with exact text "SINDICATO" in the same pale-yellow uppercase pixel type, horizontally centered beneath the emblem. Keep position number 3 and the rest of the sequence unchanged.
